title: 第9章 天字包间第10章 叶玄公子
slug: 天域丹尊第5904章不堪一击

第九章天字包间
“有错，当然有错！”莫大师已经冷静下来，一双苍眸冷冷的看着李钧，“你错在身为见习炼丹师，却毫无身为一名炼丹师的基本素养。须知丹道一途，是实践出真知，你根本没亲手实验过，又何来一口咬定对方是在演戏？”
“这……”李钧没想到莫大师会如此劈头盖脸的训斥自己，一时不由愣住。
旁边立刻有学徒七嘴八舌的说了起来：“不可能是骗人，我们都亲眼看到的。”“是啊，那位老前辈的伤势确实很快好转，不可能是作伪……”
实际上，莫大师之所以这么心急火燎的赶出来，正是因为，用阳元石和止血草配成一副治疗寒心蟒之毒的方子，这正是以前莫大师的老师潜心研究了半辈子，却始终不得要领的药方！
别看现在莫大师年纪大了，但他也有年少的时候，也有过自己的授业恩师。莫大师清楚的记得，这副药方没有其他复杂的东西，其精髓在于阳元石和止血草之间的比例，比例稍微偏差一点都不会成功。
但自己老师研究多年却始终没能得出一个正确比例。
老师临终前还特别交代过他，一定要继承自己的遗命，将这副药方研究出正确的配比来。
莫大师一直将老师的临终遗命当成圣旨，只可惜，他年过七十，老师的临终前的这个愿望还是没有实现。
所以，一听到前厅有人用阳元石和止血草治好了寒心蟒的咬伤，莫大师立刻用最快的速度赶到前厅，却还是跟对方失之交臂。
莫大师想到这里，面上难掩极度失望，又问在场的其他人：“那少年有没有说过自己的名字和来历？”
这一下，有一名学徒想了起来，连忙道：“有，我听到他说，他叫苏尘。”
“苏尘？”莫大师轻轻的念叨着这个名字，随后立刻叫来一名手下，吩咐道，“在全清河城范围内寻觅这位叫苏尘的少年，越快越好！”
当然，莫大师并不认为一个少年能有本事办到自己恩师都办不到的事情，他只认为，这少年身后必定有高人，而莫大师想找的，也是那名高人。
莫大师吩咐完了手下，正准备回后厅，眼睛余光突然看到一旁忐忑不安的李钧，莫大师的目光顿时变得冷漠起来，平静的注视李钧，冷冷的道：“你作为中级见习炼丹师，在没有任何证据的情况下随意污蔑其他炼丹师，依老夫看，这中级见习炼丹师的头衔不适合你，你还是回到炼丹学徒的位置上好好再磨炼一下吧。”
“什么？”李钧如遭雷击，他无论如何也没想到，莫大师居然因为这区区的一件小事，就剥夺了他中级见习炼丹师的头衔！
要知道，炼丹师的头衔都是由炼丹公会认证的，所以莫大师作为炼丹公会的会长，有剥夺炼丹师头衔的权力。
但，莫大师平时很少会这样做。李钧一下子变得欲哭无泪，失去了中级见习炼丹师头衔的他，还怎么在五宝堂作威作福？
如果五宝堂知道了这件事，一定会毫不犹豫的将他解雇！
更不用说，以往李钧仗着中级见习炼丹师的头衔，行事极为跋扈，不知得罪多少人。现在退回炼丹学徒的身份，恐怕往昔的那些仇人都要迫不及待的来找他算账。

几乎是转眼之间，李钧就失去了一切，而这一切只不过是因为李钧在背后非议那名少年而已。
……
话说苏尘那边，刚走出五宝堂不远，便意外的发现，方才的老者和少女并没有走远，正站在一架马车旁，远远的望着他。
紧接着，一名清秀的婢女出现在苏尘面前，低垂着头恭恭敬敬道：“公子，我家小姐为了感谢您的救命之恩，今天中午在醉仙居设宴款待公子，还望公子赏光前往。”
苏尘皱了皱眉头，刚想婉言相拒，婢女又道：“公子，我家小姐听说你之前在五宝堂求购冰雪寒蝉，这冰雪寒蝉市面上很难买到，不过我家小姐恰好知道在哪里能得到冰雪寒蝉……”
苏尘眼眸微动，最终点头说：“好吧！”
百年至阳草是给小姨治病的药材，而冰雪寒蝉，却是苏尘日后修炼一味不可或缺的材料。
既然对方知道冰雪寒蝉的消息，苏尘断没有不去赴宴之理。
那婢女听苏尘答应，这才抿唇笑道：“那么，半个时辰后，我家小姐在醉仙居天字包间等您。”
醉仙居。
是清河城最奢华的酒楼，常年宾客如云，一座难求。
当然，其中消费不低，只有那些地位高贵之人才消费得起，其中天字包间更是奢华，能在天字包间吃一餐，在清河城是绝对身份的象征。
当苏尘按照约定时间，提早来到醉仙居，便打算直奔三楼的天字包间。
只是，当他刚来到一楼的时候，恰好一间人字包间的房门打开，随后便见姜婷宜一脸难看的站在人字包间门口：“苏尘？你怎么在这里？”
“不是说了让你自己回去吗？你居然跟着我偷偷跑到这里来，要不要脸？”姜婷宜心中一股怒气升腾起来，她来醉仙居参加叶玄公子的接风洗尘宴，没想到苏尘居然偷偷的跟在她后面来了！
如果苏尘实在想来的话，直接和她说一声不就行了吗？何必当时装作没兴趣，事后又偷偷跟着她？
这样的人，真是让她倒足了胃口！
正当姜婷宜横眉怒目，想再说点什么的时候，只见又一人从人字包间走了出来，却是之前在云锦楼碰到的王冰燕。
王冰燕诧异的望了苏尘一眼，顿时不怀好意的笑了起来：“哎哟，我当是谁，原来是婷宜的表哥啊。婷宜，你带表哥来赴宴，怎么不跟我们说一声呢，快带你表哥进来给大家认识认识啊！”
姜婷宜脸色难看，嘴唇几乎要咬破了，这个苏尘真是够死皮赖脸，竟然一路跟踪着她跑到醉仙居来，而且还好巧不巧的被王冰燕撞见！

Chapter 9 Tianzi Private Room
"You are wrong, of course you are wrong!" Master Mo had calmed down and looked at Li Jun coldly with a pair of blue eyes. "You are wrong because you are a trainee alchemist, but you have no basic qualities as an alchemist. You must know that the path to alchemy is true knowledge through practice. You have never tried it yourself, so how can you insist that the other party is acting?"
"This..." Li Jun didn't expect Master Mo to scold him so openly, and couldn't help but be stunned for a moment.
Immediately some apprentices nearby started talking: "It can't be a lie, we all saw it with our own eyes." "Yes, the old senior's injury did improve quickly, it can't be a lie..."
In fact, the reason why Master Mo rushed out in such a hurry is because he used Yang Yuan Stone and Hemostatic Grass to prepare a prescription for treating the poison of the Chilling Python. This was exactly the prescription that Master Mo's teacher had been studying for half a lifetime but could never get the key to!
Even though Master Mo is older now, he also had his own mentor when he was young. Master Mo clearly remembers that there is nothing complicated about this prescription. Its essence lies in the ratio between Yang Yuan Stone and Hemostatic Grass. If the ratio is slightly off, it will not be successful.
But my teacher has been researching for many years but has never been able to come up with a correct ratio.
Before his death, the teacher specifically told him that he must inherit his legacy and work out the correct ratio of this prescription.
Master Mo has always regarded his teacher's last wish as an imperial edict. Unfortunately, he is over seventy years old, and his last wish has not yet come true.
Therefore, as soon as he heard that someone in the front hall had used Yang Yuan Stone and Hemostatic Grass to cure the bite of Hanxin Python, Master Mo immediately rushed to the front hall as quickly as possible, but still missed the opponent.
Master Mo couldn't hide his extreme disappointment when he thought of this, and asked other people present: "Has that young man ever told you his name and origin?"
At this moment, one of the apprentices remembered and said quickly: "Yes, I heard him say that his name is Su Chen."
"Su Chen?" Master Mo muttered the name softly, and then immediately called a subordinate and ordered, "Look for this young man named Su Chen in the entire Qinghe City, the sooner the better!"
Of course, Master Mo didn't think that a young man could do something that his mentor couldn't do. He only believed that there must be a master behind this young man, and the master that Master Mo wanted to find was also that master.
Master Mo finished instructing his men and was about to go back to the back hall. He suddenly saw an uneasy Li Jun beside him. Master Mo's eyes suddenly became cold. He looked at Li Jun calmly and said coldly: "As an intermediate, you see You are a trainee alchemist who arbitrarily slanders other alchemists without any evidence. In my opinion, the title of intermediate trainee alchemist is not suitable for you. You should go back to your position as an alchemist apprentice and train yourself."
"What?" Li Jun was struck by lightning. He never expected that Master Mo would deprive him of his title of intermediate trainee alchemist because of such a trivial matter!
You must know that the title of alchemist is certified by the Alchemy Guild, so Master Mo, as the president of the Alchemy Guild, has the power to deprive the alchemist of the title.
However, Master Mo rarely does this. Li Jun suddenly became tearful. How could he still dominate the Five Treasures Hall after losing his title as an intermediate trainee alchemist?
If Wubaotang knew about this, he would be fired without hesitation!
Not to mention, in the past, Li Jun relied on his title of intermediate trainee alchemist to act extremely domineeringly and offended many people. Now that he has returned to his status as an alchemy apprentice, his enemies from the past may be eager to come and settle accounts with him.
Almost in the blink of an eye, Li Jun lost everything, and all this was just because Li Jun criticized the young man behind his back.
…
As for Su Chen, he just walked outNot far from the Five Treasures Hall, he unexpectedly discovered that the old man and the young girl had not gone far, and were standing next to a carriage, looking at him from a distance.
Immediately afterwards, a pretty maidservant appeared in front of Su Chen, lowered her head and said respectfully: "Young Master, in order to thank you for your life-saving grace, my lady is hosting a banquet for the Young Master at Zuixian Residence at noon today. I hope that the Young Master will go there as a favor."
Su Chen frowned and was about to politely refuse when the maid said again: "Master, my lady heard that you were looking for ice and snow cicadas at Wubaotang. It is difficult to buy ice and snow cicadas on the market, but my lady happens to know where to get ice and snow cicadas..."
Su Chen's eyes moved slightly, and finally he nodded and said, "Okay!"
The century-old Zhiyang grass is a medicinal material used to treat my aunt's illness, while the ice, snow and cicada are indispensable materials for Su Chen's future practice.
Since the other party knew the news about Bingxue Hanchan, Su Chen had no reason not to go to the banquet.
After hearing Su Chen's promise, the maid pursed her lips and said with a smile: "Then, in half an hour, my lady will be waiting for you in the private room of Zuixianju Tianzi."
Zuixianju.
It is the most luxurious restaurant in Qinghe City. It has so many guests all year round that it is hard to find one.
Of course, the consumption is not low, and only those with noble status can afford it. Among them, the Tianzi Private Room is even more luxurious. Being able to have a meal in the Tianzi Private Room is an absolute status symbol in Qinghe City.
When Su Chen arrived at Zuixianju early as scheduled, he planned to go straight to the Tianzi private room on the third floor.
However, when he first arrived on the first floor, the door of a herringbone private room opened, and then he saw Jiang Tingyi standing at the door of the herringbone private room with an ugly face: "Su Chen? Why are you here?"
"Didn't I tell you to go back by yourself? How shameless are you to follow me and secretly come here?" Jiang Tingyi felt angry in her heart. She came to Zuixianju to participate in Master Ye Xuan's reception banquet. Unexpectedly, Su Chen secretly followed her!
If Su Chen really wanted to come, couldn't he just tell her directly? Why pretend to be uninterested at the time and follow her secretly afterwards?
Such people really turned off her appetite!
Just when Jiang Tingyi frowned and wanted to say something more, she saw another person walking out of the herringbone room, but it was Wang Bingyan who she had met in Yunjin Tower before.
Wang Bingyan glanced at Su Chen in surprise, and immediately laughed maliciously: "Oh, who did I think it was? It turns out to be Tingyi's cousin. Tingyi, you brought your cousin to the banquet, why didn't you tell us? Bring your cousin in quickly so that everyone can get to know each other!"
Jiang Tingyi's face was ugly and her lips were almost bitten. This Su Chen was so shameless that he followed her all the way to Zuixianju, and luckily she was bumped into by Wang Bingyan!
